value.rationale: Complete exact weight enumeration on an unrestricted unequal-petal clique-bouquet family refines a recognized hard graph domination invariant; it supports exact independent-color reliability, has an r=2 optimal-label degeneracy transition, and a rigorous p^2 reliability limit. These data are not determined by known minimum numbers, and handle arbitrarily many differently sized cliques.
